title: Full Moon in Gemini
tldr: A culmination and release point for the Gemini / Sagittarius axis.
theme: This Full Moon illuminates language, curiosity, learning, conversation, and the courage to name what is true now through the Gemini side of the axis, while the Sun in Sagittarius asks for integration rather than extremes.
shadow: mental loops that prevent commitment, asking endless questions to avoid choosing
integration: turning scattered information into a message that can move

twoWeekArc.teaching: This arc asks your story to update until it matches who you have become.
twoWeekArc.appPrompt: Name what the last two weeks revealed. Release the pattern that blocks the Gemini / Sagittarius balance point.

sixMonthArc.appPrompt: Look back to the same-sign New Moon. What took root because you tended it, and what grew because the soil was left untended?

ritual.function: illumination, release, cleansing, integration, and completion
ritual.timing: Use after the exact Full Moon when possible. Keep eclipse lunations under the separate witness protocol, not ordinary release ritual.
ritual.materials: Mercury kamea, yellow or white candle, agate or clear quartz, feather, water, and a writing tool.
ritual.simpleSubstitution: A white candle, water, paper, and a quiet place are enough.
ritual.action: Write what is complete, what is ready to be released, and how the higher expression of Gemini can be embodied without rejecting Sagittarius.

journalPrompt: What am I ready to release from the shadow of Gemini, and what balance with Sagittarius is asking to be lived now?
tarotPrompt: What truth is this Gemini Full Moon revealing that I can no longer avoid?
